name: Chicken with a Chinese Accent
description: A sweet and savory chicken dish with a Chinese-inspired flavor profile, featuring soya sauce and brown sugar.

recipeInstructions.text: Fry chicken breasts in a frying pan with oil and soya sauce until the outsides are done.
Transfer the chicken to a casserole dish.
Mix the remaining ingredients with soya sauce and pour over the chicken.
Bake for 35 minutes at 350°F.
Serve the chicken with rice.

keywords: Chinese chicken, sweet and savory, baked chicken

_similar.name: Chicken Celebrity
_similar.description: A sweet and savory chicken dish with a ketchup-based sauce, perfect for baking.

recipeInstructions.text: Arrange chicken parts in a small roaster or casserole.
Mix the rest of the ingredients together. Spoon over chicken, covering all pieces.
Bake in a 350°F oven for 1 hour or until tender.

_similar.keywords: baked chicken, sweet and savory, ketchup-based sauce

_similar.name: Sweet and Sour Pineapple with Chicken and Ginger
_similar.description: A classic sweet and sour dish featuring parboiled chicken legs in a tangy pineapple and ginger sauce, served over fried rice.

recipeInstructions.text: Rinse and separate chicken legs at the joint. Parboil for 15 to 20 minutes to remove excess fat.
Saute onions and celery in vegetable oil until tender. Add drained mushrooms and cook briefly.
Dissolve chicken Oxo cube in hot water. Add soya sauce, ginger, salt, sugar, and vinegar. Bring to a boil.
Mix cornstarch with cold water until smooth. Pour into boiling sauce and stir frequently until thickened.
Add drained pineapple to the sauce. Adjust seasoning with pineapple juice if desired.
Lay parboiled chicken pieces in a greased casserole dish. Pour sauce over the chicken.
Bake at 350°F for 20 to 25 minutes until bubbling.
Serve over Chicken Vegetable Fried Rice.

_similar.keywords: sweet and sour chicken, pineapple chicken, ginger sauce

_similar.name: Sweet & Sour Pineapple Chicken
_similar.description: A sweet and tangy chicken dish baked in a pineapple-based sauce, perfect for a comforting meal.
recipeIngredient: ⅗ cup (¼ cup + 2 Tbsp) crushed pineapple, drained

recipeInstructions.text: Simmer the chicken breasts in water until cooked through, turning occasionally.
In a pan, combine crushed pineapple, vinegar, brown sugar, salt, ketchup, and water. Cook over heat, stirring until the sauce thickens.
Place the cooked chicken in a casserole dish and pour the sweet and sour sauce over the top.
Cover the dish with tinfoil and bake at 325°F for 1½ hours.

_similar.keywords: sweet and sour chicken, pineapple chicken, baked chicken

_similar.name: Chicken and Broccoli
_similar.description: A creamy chicken and broccoli pasta bake with Parmesan cheese and mushroom soup.

recipeInstructions.text: Cook the small shells pasta according to package directions. Drain.
Add cooked broccoli, chopped chicken, cream of mushroom soup, milk, Parmesan cheese, and ground pepper to the cooked pasta.
Boil the mixture for 2 minutes to heat through and combine the sauce.
Serve hot with a cranberry salad.

_similar.keywords: chicken and broccoli, pasta bake, creamy chicken

_similar.name: Chicken Supreme
_similar.description: A hearty chicken dish with tomatoes, herbs, and cheese, baked to perfection and served over rice or pasta.

recipeInstructions.text: Boil the chicken breasts in a separate container until pink is gone (about 1/4 of the way cooked).
In a baking or roasting pan, mix together the tomato ingredients (stewed tomatoes, green pepper, onion, basil, oregano, garlic).
Place the partially cooked chicken breasts in the bottom of the pan.
Sprinkle spices over the chicken breasts.
Pour the remaining tomato mixture on top of the chicken breasts.
Cover and bake at 350°F for approximately ½ hour.
Sprinkle grated cheese on top, cover, and bake for an additional 15 minutes.
Serve over rice or pasta.

_similar.keywords: chicken supreme, baked chicken, Italian-style chicken
